# LinkedIn post — Apollo economist questions AI’s financial payoff outside Big Tech

Date: 2026-10-25
Source: https://news.google.?oc=5
Related news: data/news.yaml

---

The AI investment debate is moving from capability to measurable return.

Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok argues that most companies outside the technology sector have not yet shown a financial payoff from AI. That is an assessment, not a causal study—but it points to a real governance gap.

Enterprise AI programmes need to show:
- a credible pre-AI baseline;
- full costs, including integration, controls and human review;
- business outcomes such as cycle time, quality, loss avoidance or revenue—not usage alone.

For AI leaders, the strongest answer to scepticism is not a bigger model. It is better measurement.
